---
name: privacy-memory
description: Apply BonBazaar privacy and memory isolation rules whenever user data, memory, telemetry or learning is involved.
---

Rules:
- Keep each user's private memory isolated.
- Training/learning from user content is opt-in, never default.
- Prefer anonymous evaluation signals over raw private conversations.
- Never store secrets, passwords, tokens, medical data or other highly sensitive content as general training data.
- Provide deletion/export paths for stored user data before public release.
- Log the version and purpose of any learning rule, not the user's private raw content.
